summary: Atlanticus Holdings completed the sale of its CAR Auto Finance operations, representing its entire Auto Finance segment, to an unaffiliated third party on September 17, 2026. Total consideration was approximately $71.2 million, comprising $56.2 million cash and a $15.0 million seller note. Roughly 154 CAR employees transition to the buyer. The company will no longer operate an Auto Finance segment and expects the deal to strengthen its balance sheet while focusing capital on consumer credit. No board recommendation, advisor, premium, or regulatory details were disclosed. Watch for seller-note credit risk and redeployment of proceeds.
